metadata.description: An agent organization structured as a C-suite hierarchy. Each department installs independently so only the relevant function loads.

plugins.name: executive
plugins.description: Direction, capital and attention allocation, cross-functional arbitration, strategy validation, and the method for structuring the organization itself.

plugins.name: technology
plugins.description: Architecture, engineering delivery, development discipline, infrastructure, data platform, and AI/automation systems.

plugins.name: product
plugins.description: Product strategy, discovery, UX and usability, design systems, brand expression in the interface, and release success criteria.

plugins.name: marketing
plugins.description: Positioning, demand generation, SEO, paid acquisition, content and social production, and external communications.

plugins.name: revenue
plugins.description: Sales, prospecting and outreach, pricing and packaging, monetization, activation, retention, and partnerships.

plugins.name: finance
plugins.description: Planning and budgeting, forecasting, unit economics, cash and capital allocation, and financial controls.

plugins.name: operations
plugins.description: Cross-functional process, program and delivery management, capacity, vendors and supply chain, and operational quality.

plugins.name: people
plugins.description: Org design, hiring and leveling, compensation, performance and development, culture, and employee relations.

plugins.name: legal-risk
plugins.description: Contracts and commitments, IP and licensing, regulatory compliance and privacy, enterprise risk, and audit readiness.

plugins.name: administration
plugins.description: Corporate records and governance, board support, insurance and continuity, workplace, and shared services.
